subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core `/stream` session command backed by `SessionEntry.streamingMode` and a new `previewStreamingSessionOverride` channel capability for Telegram, Discord, and Slack?
rationale: This is an additive user-facing feature plus a plugin/session contract change, and the linked issue is already labeled as needing product decision rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor the MVP after repair and proof
options.body: Accept the command/capability shape after the persistence fix lands and current-head live channel proof is supplied.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Keep the PR open but require a maintainer-approved storage/capability shape before further implementation work.

options.title: Decline the core command
options.body: Leave preview streaming mode as config-only or move any optional workflow into plugin-owned surfaces later.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the MVP after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the command/capability shape after the persistence fix lands and current-head live channel proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-management ownership makes this the best available product/session contract owner from the history reviewed.
